[[Pokémon World Tournament]] }} '''Colress Machine''' (Japanese: '''VSキュレムII''' ''VS Kyurem II''), titled '''VS Kyurem II''' in the [[Shogakukan Asia]] translation, is the 537th chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the 13th chapter of the {{MangaArc|Black 2 & White 2}}. It is subtitled '''Kyurem II''' (Japanese: '''アクロマ・マシーン''' ''{{tt|Achroma|Colress}} Machine'') in the [[VIZ Media]] translation and '''Colress Machine''' in the Shogakukan Asia translation. ==Plot== {{incomplete plot}} ==Major events== * [[Zinzolin]] continues his battle against [[Colress]]. * {{adv|Blake}} exits the [[Relic Passage]] and arrives next to the [[Pokémon World Tournament]] construction site. * Blake is revealed to have captured a {{p|Kabutops}} named Kabutott and a {{p|Gliscor}} named Glisott. * Blake finds Zinzolin defeated by {{DL|Forces of nature (Adventures)|Thundurus}} and {{DL|Forces of nature (Adventures)|Landorus}}, who proceed to transform into their Therian Formes. * Colress reveals he is in possession of the [[Reveal Glass]]. * {{OBP|Mom|Black 2 and White 2|Whitley's mother}} tells {{adv|Whitley}} everything about the black-suited {{tc|Team Plasma Grunt}}s, the [[Colress Machine]], and the microchip in her pendant. * Whitley decides to find her missing pendant so that she may give it to [[Rood]] or [[Gorm]]. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== ====Pokémon debuts==== * {{p|Thundurus}} (Therian Forme) * {{p|Landorus}} (Therian Forme) ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|Blake}} * {{adv|Whitley}} * {{adv|Looker}} * {{adv|N}} (fantasy) * [[Roxie]] * [[Colress]] * [[Zinzolin]] * {{OBP|Mom|Black 2 and White 2|Whitley's mother}} * {{tc|Team Plasma Grunt}}s (flashback) ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Reshiram}} ({{DL|Tao trio (Adventures)|Reshiram|Black's}};
